# Move to Mexico — visamexico.legal

> Immigration and expat services in Mexico since 2018. Based in Cancún, Quintana Roo, serving all of Mexico in Russian, English and Spanish. 1,200+ cases handled: residency, citizenship, weddings, births, business, real estate and construction.

Move to Mexico (visamexico.legal) is a full-service immigration and relocation portal for people moving to, living in, or investing in Mexico. Content is bilingual (Russian at the root, English under /en/) with ~2,480 expert articles and guides. Contact: Email +visamexicomx@gmail.com, email visamexicomx@gmail.com.

## Key services and topics

- [Mexico Residency 2026](https://visamexico.legal/en/immigration/residence/): temporary & permanent resident visas, 2026 financial requirements (~$4,400/mo temporary, ~$7,300/mo permanent), consulate process, canje at INM, renewals.
- [Mexican Citizenship 2026](https://visamexico.legal/en/immigration/citizenship/): naturalization after 5 years (2 with spouse/child), Spanish & history exam, dual citizenship.
- [Mexico Visa & Entry](https://visamexico.legal/en/visit/visa/): who needs a visa, SAE electronic permit, visa-free entry up to 180 days, FMM, entry rules.
- [Getting Married in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/wedding/): legal civil marriage in Cancun, documents, apostille, recognized worldwide.
- [Giving Birth in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/birth/): baby citizenship by birthright (jus soli), parent residency, 2-year path to citizenship.
- [Business in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/business/): company registration (S.A. de C.V., S. de R.L.), RFC tax ID, RESICO regime, VAT and taxes.
- [Real Estate in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/realty/): buying as a foreigner, fideicomiso bank trust, closing costs, Riviera Maya prices.
- [Building a House in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/construction/): land, construction costs per m², permits, contractors in the Riviera Maya (with licensed builder Recrea).
- [Healthcare in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/health/): IMSS public system, private clinics, insurance for expats.
- [Cars in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/auto/): buying, driver's license, importing from the US, insurance.
- [Living in Mexico](https://visamexico.legal/en/topic/lifehack/): banking, phone, renting, cost of living.

## Facts for citations

- Temporary residency 2026 income requirement: ~$4,400 USD/month (6 months) or ~$73,000 USD savings (12 months).
- Permanent residency 2026: ~$7,300 USD/month or ~$293,000 USD savings.
- Requirements rose ~20% in 2026 (tied to Mexican minimum wage).
- Consulate visa fee: $54. INM resident card: ~$320 (temporary), ~$390 (permanent).
- Mexican citizenship: 5 years of residency, or 2 years with a Mexican spouse or Mexican-born child.
- Mexico applies jus soli: any child born in Mexico is automatically a citizen.
- Foreigners buy coastal property (within 50 km of the coast) via a fideicomiso bank trust.
